description: Defines the UpdateableAppsHeader class and its nested classes, managing the display and interaction logic for a header section showing updateable apps in an Android app.

classes.name: UpdateableAppsHeader
classes.description: Represents a header section for updateable apps, including a list of apps and an adapter.

classes.name: UpdateableAppsHeader.Delegate
classes.description: Adapter delegate for binding UpdateableAppsHeader views within a RecyclerView.

classes.name: UpdateableAppsHeader.ViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder managing the UI components of the header, handling user interactions and data binding.

methods.name: UpdateableAppsHeader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the header with activity context, adapter, and list of updateable apps.

methods.name: Delegate
methods.description: Constructor setting up the delegate with activity context.

methods.name: isForViewType
methods.description: Determines if the delegate is responsible for the given item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for the header view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: ViewHolder
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: bindHeader
methods.description: Binds header data to UI components.

methods.name: updateToggleButtonText
methods.description: Updates the toggle button text based on current state.
